title: Warning
description: A warning on a beat's version (§10, §14 warning).

version.description: The beat version it was made on.

sentence.description: The 1-based number of the sentence it is about, in the server's split of the version's text (§15 Sentences); null when it is about no one sentence.

reason.description: Why it was raised (a banned phrase: the phrase).

ignore_reason.description: The user's reason for ignoring it; later checks are told it.
